// Optional file-only oracle. Uses public protobuf types, never Pulse encoders.
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	collector "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/collector/trace/v1"
	common "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/common/v1"
	resource "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/resource/v1"
	trace "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/trace/v1"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/encoding/protojson"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
)

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func write(dir, name string, data []byte) { must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name), data, 0600)) }
func encode(value any) []byte {
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
	must(err)
	return append(data, '\n')
}

func ids(value any) {
	switch v := value.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		for key, child := range v {
			if key == "traceId" || key == "spanId" || key == "parentSpanId" {
				bytes, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(child.(string))
				must(err)
				v[key] = hex.EncodeToString(bytes)
			} else {
				ids(child)
			}
		}
	case []any:
		for _, child := range v {
			ids(child)
		}
	}
}

func main() {
	dir := os.Args[1]
	must(os.MkdirAll(dir, 0700))
	owners := []struct {
		name   string
		fresh  func() proto.Message
		fields []string
	}{
		{"resource", func() proto.Message { return &resource.Resource{} }, []string{"droppedAttributesCount"}},
		{"scope", func() proto.Message { return &common.InstrumentationScope{} }, []string{"droppedAttributesCount"}},
		{"span", func() proto.Message { return &trace.Span{} }, []string{"droppedAttributesCount", "droppedEventsCount", "droppedLinksCount", "flags"}},
		{"event", func() proto.Message { return &trace.Span_Event{} }, []string{"droppedAttributesCount"}},
		{"link", func() proto.Message { return &trace.Span_Link{} }, []string{"droppedAttributesCount", "flags"}},
	}
	literals := []string{"0", "-0", "1", "1.0", "1.000", "1e3", "1E+3", "10e-1", "4294967295", "4.294967295e9", "42949672950e-1", "4294967296", "-1", "1e-1", "1e-1000", "1.00000000000000000001", "0e1000000", "-0e-1000000", "1e1000000", "1e-1000000", "01", "+1", ".0", "1.", " 1", "1 ", "", "NaN", "Infinity", "SPAN_KIND_SERVER", "1x", "1e", "--1", "0x1"}
	var cases []map[string]any
	for _, owner := range owners {
		for _, field := range owner.fields {
			for _, literal := range literals {
				body := encode(map[string]any{field: literal})
				message := owner.fresh()
				err := protojson.Unmarshal(body, message)
				row := map[string]any{"owner": owner.name, "field": field, "literal": literal, "accepted": err == nil}
				if err == nil {
					canonical, err := (protojson.MarshalOptions{EmitUnpopulated: true, UseEnumNumbers: true}).Marshal(message)
					must(err)
					var values map[string]any
					must(json.Unmarshal(canonical, &values))
					row["expected"] = values[field]
				}
				cases = append(cases, row)
			}
		}
	}
	write(dir, "cases.json", encode(cases))

	// Separate original input, public canonical JSON and wire. Context IDs here
	// use Google's generic base64 spelling; only the derived OTLP JSON uses hex.
	input := []byte(`{"resourceSpans":[{"resource":{"droppedAttributesCount":"4294967295"},"scopeSpans":[{"scope":{"name":"uint32.fixture","droppedAttributesCount":"10e-1"},"spans":[{"traceId":"MDEyMzQ1Njc4OWFiY2RlZg==","spanId":"YWJjZGVmZ2g=","name":"quoted-counts","kind":2,"startTimeUnixNano":"1700000000123456789","endTimeUnixNano":"1700000000123456799","flags":"4.294967295e9","droppedAttributesCount":"1.0","droppedEventsCount":"1e3","droppedLinksCount":"42949672950e-1","events":[{"name":"event","timeUnixNano":"1700000000123456790","droppedAttributesCount":"4294967295"}],"links":[{"traceId":"MDEyMzQ1Njc4OWFiY2RlZg==","spanId":"aWprbG1ub3A=","flags":"4294967295","droppedAttributesCount":"-0"}],"status":{"code":1}}]}]}]}`)
	write(dir, "google-input.json", input)
	request := &collector.ExportTraceServiceRequest{}
	must(protojson.Unmarshal(input, request))
	canonical, err := (protojson.MarshalOptions{UseEnumNumbers: true}).Marshal(request)
	must(err)
	write(dir, "google-canonical.json", canonical)
	wire, err := proto.MarshalOptions{Deterministic: true}.Marshal(request)
	must(err)
	write(dir, "request.protobuf", wire)
	for _, item := range []struct {
		name string
		data []byte
	}{{"input.json", input}, {"canonical.json", canonical}} {
		var tree any
		must(json.Unmarshal(item.data, &tree))
		ids(tree)
		write(dir, item.name, encode(tree))
	}
	files := map[string]string{}
	for _, name := range []string{"cases.json", "google-input.json", "google-canonical.json", "input.json", "canonical.json", "request.protobuf", "produce.go.txt", "producer.go.mod.txt", "producer.go.sum.txt"} {
		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, name))
		must(err)
		sum := sha256.Sum256(data)
		files[name] = hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	}
	write(dir, "checksums.json", encode(map[string]any{"otlp": "v1.9.0", "google_protobuf": "v1.36.11", "files": files}))
}
